title: Minneapolis Property Assessments
description: The Minneapolis assessor's parcel file: address, owner as published, land/building/total value, property type, zoning, year built, area, bedrooms, bathrooms, units, construction and heating. Filter by address, neighborhood, type, value or owner.
why: The assessor's own record of every parcel in the city, with the building characteristics that listing sites hide behind a login.
useCases: Investors screening by value, units and year built
Appraisers and tax-appeal consultants pulling comps

neighborhood.title: Neighborhood
neighborhood.description: Neighborhood name as the assessor writes it, e.g. WHITTIER

minTotalValue.title: Minimum total value (USD)
minTotalValue.description: Only parcels assessed at or above this value.
